verdict.rationale: BigCommerce publishes extensive first-party docs for REST and GraphQL APIs (Storefront API, API reference, webhooks) explicitly aimed at building headless/automated integrations, which is a strong documented public API surface for programmatic control. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of API completeness and reliability at scale (one older community report cites API throttling/connection issues, though this is a reliability complaint rather than a contradiction of the API's existence or documentation).
